info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Administration API
info.description: The Counterparty Administration API provides access to essential market data related to counterparties within the banking domain. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about various counterparties, facilitating informed decision-making and streamlined operations. It is designed for financial institutions, traders, and risk managers looking to manage and analyze counterparty information effectively. Through this API, developers can integrate critical counterparty data into their applications or systems, promoting enhanced compliance and risk assessment capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about the counterparty administration records. It provides insights into the counterparties managed within the market data system, including their attributes and statuses.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the administration of counterparties in the market data. It specifies the necessary parameters to filter and structure the data returned by the operation.

200.description: Successful retrieval of counterparty administration data.

GetCounterpartyAdministrationRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to counterparty administration in market data.
